# FQHESphereBosonEntanglementEntropy

Module: **FQHE** · directory: `FQHE/src/FQHEOnSphere` · binary: `FQHE/src/Programs/FQHEOnSphere/FQHESphereBosonEntanglementEntropy`

```text
FQHESphereEntanglementEntropy, version 0.01

Usage: FQHESphereEntanglementEntropy [options] 

Options:

system options:
    --ground-file : name of the file corresponding to the ground state of the whole system
    --haldane : use Haldane basis instead of the usual n-body basis
    --symmetrized-basis : use Lz <-> -Lz symmetrized version of the basis (only valid if total-lz=0)
    --reference-file : use a file as the definition of the reference state
    -p, --nbr-particles : number of particles (override autodetection from input file name if non zero) (default value = 0)
    -l, --lzmax : twice the maximum momentum for a single particle (override autodetection from input file name if non zero) (default value = 0)
    -z, --total-lz : twice the total momentum projection for the system (override autodetection from input file name if greater or equal to zero) (default value = -1)
    --huge-basis : use huge Hilbert space support
    --memory : maximum memory (in MBytes) that can allocated for precalculations when using huge mode (default value = 100)
    --min-la : minimum size of the subsystem whose entropy has to be evaluated (default value = 1)
    --max-la : maximum size of the subsystem whose entropy has to be evaluated (0 if equal to half the total system size) (default value = 0)
    --shift-la : index of the first orbital that is part of the subsystem whose entropy has to be evaluated (0 is the orbital at the north pole) (default value = 0)
    --stripe-subsystem : use a stripe center around the equator as the subsystem
    --degenerated-groundstate : single column file describing a degenerated ground state
    --use-rational : use rational numbers for the groundstates (only available in SVD mode)

precalculation options:
    --load-hilbert : load Hilbert space description from the indicated file (only available for the Haldane basis)
    --huge-memory : maximum memory (in MBytes) that can allocated for precalculations when using huge mode (default value = 100)

output options:
    -o, --output-file : use this file name instead of the one that can be deduced from the input file name (replacing the vec extension with ent extension
    --density-matrix : store the eigenvalues of the partial density matrices to a given file
    --density-eigenstate : compute the eigenstates of the reduced density matrix
    --na-eigenstate : compute the eigenstates of the reduced density matrix only for a subsystem with a fixed number of particles (default value = 0)
    --lza-eigenstate : compute the eigenstates of the reduced density matrix only for a subsystem with a fixed total Lz value (default value = 0)
    --nbr-eigenstates : number of reduced density matrix eigenstates to compute (0 if all) (default value = 0)
    --full-densitymatrix : store full density matrices to a given file
    --rank-entanglementmatrix : store the rank of each blook of the entanglement matrix (only available in SVD mode)

tools options:
    --use-svd : use singular value decomposition instead of diagonalization to compute the entropy
    --use-lapack : use LAPACK libraries instead of DiagHam libraries

misc options:
    -h, --help : display this help

global options:
    --append-cmdline : append command line to file
```
